Hook.Purpose: Smoke-grep for private env imported from universal/client files.
Hook.Command: find src -type f \( -name '*.svelte' -o -name '+page.ts' -o -name '+layout.ts' \) -print0 | xargs -0 grep -nE "\\\$env/(static|dynamic)/private" || true
Hook.Expected: Empty output. Matches must move to `+page.server.ts` / `+layout.server.ts` / `$lib/server/`.
